title: Dyadic shell decomposition of T and ∂T along the level sets of f (shells, slices, boundary relations, masses)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ; T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) (domain univ) represented by an IMRep RT = (M, θ, ξ) in univ; RB = (M', θ', ξ') an IMRep in univ representing ∂T; K ⊆ ℝ^P closed with T vanishing off K; f : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous; r : ℕ → ℝ antitone; and Z_j ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (j ∈ ℕ) with Z_j(ω) = ∫_{M∩{f<r_j}} θ⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{m+1} − ∫_{M'∩{f<r_j}} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dH^m for every j and ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P). Put E_j := K ∩ {x : r_j ≤ f(x)}. Then there are W_j, A_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) and D_j ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (j ∈ ℕ) such that: every W_j and D_j is integer multiplicity; W_j, D_j and Z_j vanish off E_j; ∂W_0(ω) = D_0(ω) − Z_0(ω) and ∂W_{j+1}(ω) = D_{j+1}(ω) + Z_j(ω) − Z_{j+1}(ω) for all j, ω; Σ_{j=0}^{N} W_j(ω) = T(ω) − A_N(ω) for all N, ω; M(W_0) = μ_RT({r_0 ≤ f}), M(W_{j+1}) = μ_RT({r_{j+1} ≤ f < r_j}), M(D_0) = μ_RB({r_0 ≤ f}), M(D_{j+1}) = μ_RB({r_{j+1} ≤ f < r_j}) and M(A_N) = μ_RT({f < r_N}).
